pages.text: Every lens is made the same way: study the crystal, grow it pure, cut it true. Three machines do it - the $(item)X-ray Diffractometer$(), the $(item)Crystal Growth Furnace$() and the $(item)Optical Workshop$() - and what they make goes into the telescopes and more.

The crystals come from everywhere: quartz and calcite from the Overworld, fluorspar from calcite and geodes, and from the Planetary Interior corundum, garnet and moissanite. Glass - fused silica - has no crystal lattice at all, so it needs no study before it is cut.
